name: Strapi
description: Strapi is the leading open-source headless CMS built by Strapi SAS in Paris. Its community edition (MIT) provides a customizable content API with a self-hosted admin panel supporting REST and GraphQL, enabling developers to structure and deliver content to any frontend without vendor lock-in.

owner.name: Strapi SAS
owner.description: French company behind the leading open-source headless CMS.
